title: Opera browser profile
whyItMatters: The Opera profile holds history, sessions, bookmarks and saved logins. Anyone who takes the disk can see what was browsed and which sites kept the user signed in.
source: Opera Help, About Opera shows the profile path; Opera keeps user data in Roaming under Opera Software/Opera Stable: https://help.opera.com/en/latest/
notes: Opera is Chromium-based but keeps its user data in Roaming, with the profile in a Default subfolder (newer builds). Older builds put Preferences directly in Opera Stable. Opera GX uses Opera GX Stable; Beta and Developer builds have their own folders.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Opera, open the password manager in Settings and export your saved passwords to a file you keep; export bookmarks as HTML too.
cleanup.signOut: In Opera, open Settings > Synchronization and sign out, so the browser stops syncing with your Opera account.
steps: Uninstall Opera from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Opera profile folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Opera profile on this PC: history, bookmarks, saved logins, cookies and open tabs.
